items.name: Fluorine
items.note: The most reactive element; it protects teeth in tiny amounts.

items.name: Chlorine
items.note: A sharp green gas that cleans water and makes salt with sodium.

items.name: Bromine
items.note: One of only two elements that are liquid at room temperature; a brown, sharp liquid.

items.name: Iodine
items.note: Used to test for starch, to treat thyroids, and in disinfectants.

items.name: Astatine
items.note: The rarest natural element on Earth; almost nothing is known of it.

items.name: Tennessine
items.note: Made in laboratories; named for the state of Tennessee.
